hazards.evidence: White toilet seat blends with white toilet and light-colored floor, reducing visual contrast and increasing risk of misperception or misstep for someone with dementia.
Dark bath mat on light tile floor creates high contrast that may be misperceived as a hole or step, potentially causing hesitation or tripping.
Plugged-in hair dryer left on the sink counter poses a burn or electrocution risk if used unsupervised or near water.
